summary_ja: 承認申請書の記載事項の変更等があった場合の遅滞ない届出義務を定める。
summary_en: Requires prompt notification to the Commissioner when matters in the approval application change or approval standards cease to be met.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall, in any of the following cases, promptly notify the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency of that fact and its details. (i) Where there has been a change in the matters stated in the written application for approval under Article 287. (ii) Where there has been a material change in the matters stated in the documents attached to the written application for approval under Article 287. (iii) Where grounds have arisen for not conforming to the approval standards provided for in the preceding Article.
